approvedQuotes.text: I was promoted at Oakland Hospital after 49 years as a Psychotherapist. It was a surprise, but a nice one.

I've seen Maren Johns get promoted, and I heard they work as a Psychotherapist in Rockridge. I don't know them personally, but it's nice to see people getting recognized for their work, especially after 49 years. It's a big deal.
I've noticed that people around here are being more watchful lately, and there's been some sharp talk about rent on the block. It's making me a bit more aware of my surroundings.
